paragraphs: He is mentioned in Berakhot 35b, according to the reading of the She'iltot, parashat Bo; and our reading there is R' Yehoshua ben Kafosai.[^1][^2]

notes.text: לה: gives Berakhot 35b under the colon convention; פ׳ בא is contextually parashat Bo. The Sheiltot reading and our reading are Hyman’s attributions, without fresh collation or identifying his edition.

Yehudah bar Karpus differs in both personal name and patronymic from Yehoshua ben Kafosai. Catalog רבי and indexed קרפוסי do not replace supplied ר׳ and קרפוס. Both titles remain R', with no authority or identity merger.
